title: 12955(n)
requirement: Housing providers must evaluate the aggregate income of all persons residing together using the same standards applied to married persons.
quoted_span: To use a financial or income standard in the rental of housing that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing together or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income of married persons residing together or proposing to reside together.

title: 12955(o)(1)(A)
requirement: For tenants with government rent subsidies, housing providers must base financial or income eligibility standards only on the portion of rent the tenant is responsible for paying.
coverage_conditions: housing accommodations with a government rent subsidy
quoted_span: Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.

title: 12955(o)(1)(B)
requirement: For tenants with government rent subsidies, housing providers must allow applicants to provide alternative evidence of their ability to pay rent instead of relying solely on credit history.
coverage_conditions: housing accommodations with a government rent subsidy
quoted_span: Use a person’s credit history as part of the application process for a rental accommodation without offering the applicant the option, at the applicant’s discretion, of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of the applicant’s reasonable ability to pay the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant
